'''Darth Hoth Fun With TIEs V2.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''GPN category:''' Standard

== Strategy ==

A very basic deck using the retrieval of SFS. Use Twi'lek Advisors to get SFS a soon as possible, and use Mob Points combo to get Wakeelmui. Battle whereever possible, lose a few TIEs, send 1 to Return To Base and another to used pile. Use Commander Brandei to search for TIEs each turn, that way you get more retrieval. All the planets are parsec 4-8, that way I can just let Admiral Chiraneu sit at a parsec 6 and add 1 to drain where my other SDs are. Fel is used to add to battle destiny and DS-181-4 is used to react. To get the systems, rely on Admiral Piett to pull Commander Merrjyk (could pull Brandei if I want him to). For some large retrieval later in the game, use Short-range Fighters. I'm not sure what I should add for the last effect I'm starting with Prepared Defenses.

Shewski:Thanks, thought the Inconsequential Losses thing through half way (was a long day and I was pretty much asleep). I don't like the War Room thing, too many people in my area play MBO. I'll consider the Gunner/Strategic Reserves, just need to find something to take out.
